one_liner: Email marketing platform with APIs for campaigns, audiences, and transactional messaging.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp Marketing API supports authentication via API key or OAuth 2 access token
evidence.quote: You can authenticate requests using either your API key or an OAuth access token, depending on your use case.

evidence.claim: Developers can self-serve generate API keys from their account
evidence.quote: Use this guide to start using the Mailchimp Marketing API. Learn how to generate your API key, install the client library, and make your first API call.

evidence.claim: The Marketing API exposes a broad REST surface covering campaigns, lists, automations, reports, e-commerce, and more
evidence.quote: Use the API to manage workflows, emails, and queues for Classic Automations. See Merge Field documentation for more.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp ships an official MCP server for its Transactional Messaging API
evidence.quote: Our MCP specifically allows you to interact with the Transactional Messaging API, give onboarding help regarding Transactional Messaging, and submit feedback.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp offers a risk-free 14-day trial signup without a credit card, indicating self-serve account access
evidence.quote: Join Mailchimp with a risk-free 14-day trial. [Start Today — no credit card required.](https://mailchimp.com/signup/)

notes: Official MCP is Transactional (Mandrill) only; no official Marketing API MCP per Scalekit. API reference lists ~25+ resource groups (Campaigns, Lists, Reports, E-commerce, SMS, etc.), so breadth is broad. Open Commerce product uses GraphQL but is separate from the core Marketing/Transactional REST APIs. Audiences endpoints are in BETA with separate terms.
